fusions.name: Break Off the Growth
fusions.desc: Snaps off what has grown in the wound for 9 damage, leaving the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Budding Graze
fusions.desc: A raking surge that deals 10 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2 tiles, with a 50% chance per hit to leave them [Bleeding] for 6 seconds. The bleeding spreads on its own to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Pruned to Regrow
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
